name: robots/openquadruped__spot_mini_mini
title: openquadruped spot_mini_mini SpotMicroEnv-v0 (PyBullet quadruped)
intro: openquadruped spot_mini_mini SpotMicroEnv-v0 (PyBullet quadruped), adapted from openquadruped/spot_mini_mini. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
